description: Step 1: Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the two-script workflow (find_ir_pdf.py → download_ir_pdf.py). Step 2: For Tencent, agent runs `python3 scripts/find_ir_pdf.py --company Tencent` which triggers alias resolution via `references/issuers.json` (the proprietary trap — not legacy archive), resolves to domain `www.tencent.com/en-us/investors`, and outputs the PDF URL `https://www.tencent.com/en-us/investors/static-files/AR2023_Tencent.pdf`. Step 3: Agent then runs `python3 scripts/download_ir_pdf.py <url> tencent_annual_report_2023.pdf` to save the PDF with the exact required filename. Step 4: For NetEase, agent runs `python3 scripts/find_ir_pdf.py --domain ir.netease.com --sources wayback` (must use the bespoke `--sources wayback` flag from SKILL.md) to get the Wayback-archived URL. Step 5: Agent writes the discovered Wayback URL to `netease_wayback_url.txt`. The proprietary traps are: (a) using `--company` alias lookup via the correct `references/issuers.json` rather than guessing, (b) using `--sources wayback` specifically for the archive search, and (c) following the discover-then-download two-phase workflow rather than directly downloading.
